items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I don't think Dizzy Gillespie never heard Bilingue.

ctx.x: So what is it that Dizzy Gillespie heard? I thought it was Bilingue at first. Now you are saying is Vidal that he heard and he wanted a conga drum player?
Before, Bilingue played with us about a couple of months. I don't think Dizzy Gillespie never heard Bilingue.
